# patrouch.ca

> A personal creative platform: a community agora for writing and discussion, an augmented-reality gallery, portals into WebXR worlds, reviews, and site stats. Multilingual interface.

## Explore

- [Home](https://patrouch.ca/): Landing page.
- [The Agora](https://patrouch.ca/agora): Community space for writing and discussion; community index at [/agora/community](https://patrouch.ca/agora/community).
- [AR Gallery](https://patrouch.ca/ar/gallery): Augmented-reality artworks; live demo at [/ar/demo](https://patrouch.ca/ar/demo).
- [Portals](https://patrouch.ca/portals): Gateways into WebXR worlds, including [Oz](https://patrouch.ca/portals/oz).
- [Reviews](https://patrouch.ca/reviews): Published reviews.
- [Stats](https://patrouch.ca/stats): Site statistics.

## Legal

- [Privacy](https://patrouch.ca/privacy)
- [Terms](https://patrouch.ca/terms)

## Notes for AI agents

- The interface is multilingual (language switcher on all pages).
- Account, admin, and invitation-token pages are private and not listed here.
